newsitem.title: GERMANY: Delta starts daily Stuttgart-Atlanta flights.
newsitem.headline: Delta starts daily Stuttgart-Atlanta flights.

text.p: Delta Air Lines said it started a daily nonstop service from Stuttgart to its Atlanta hub on Monday.
The U.S. carrier said it would operate the new route with a Lockheed 10-11 aircraft with 214 seats.
Delta's southern Germany sales manager, Robert Keysselitz, said the airline was targeting the attractive south-west German business travel sector which was seen as a growth market.

In a statement, Hermann Schaufler, transport minister of the state of Baden-Wuerttemberg, said: "Delta has taken the right decision. There is a market of 1,350 passengers who fly daily from the Stuttgart area to the USA and it will grow further."
State economics minister Walter Doering added that exports from Baden-Wuerttemberg to the USA in 1996 were worth 14 billion marks while US imports were worth more than eight billion marks.
Delta has daily flights between Berlin, Frankfurt and Munich and the USA.
